complexity.notes: Uses division (prod // num), so it does not satisfy the O(n) no-division follow-up; the standard prefix/suffix product approach would. The slices nums[:zero] and nums[zero+1:] allocate O(n) extra space and could be avoided by iterating with indices. The match/case on the zero count is readable but unconventional for this problem.
complexity.summary: Counts zeros to branch into three cases: more than one zero yields all zeros; exactly one zero yields the product of non-zero elements at the zero's index; otherwise divides the total product by each element. Each case is a linear pass over the array.
